research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: PagerDuty is focused on enhancing IT operations through various technologies. They are developing systems for outage risk detection, which involve monitoring events to identify potential service disruptions. Their research includes modifying event notification configurations based on incident resolution data, and using machine learning for inline categorizing of events. They also explore service dependencies using relationship network graphs and provide action recommendations for operational issues. These efforts aim to improve incident management and operational efficiency.

overview_description.description: PagerDuty is an operations performance platform delivering visibility and actionable intelligence across the entire incident lifecycle.  Their SaaS-based solution empowers over 10,000 small, mid-size, and enterprise global customers such as Comcast, eHarmony, Slack, and Lululemon with the insight to intelligently respond to critical disruptions for exceptional customer experience. PagerDuty was founded to deliver a new and innovative approach to increase business response and efficiency. When brand reputation depends on customer satisfaction, PagerDuty arms businesses with the insight to proactively manage incidents and events that may impact customers across their IT environment.

about_short_description.short_description: PagerDuty is an operations performance platform that helps monitor IT infrastructure, detect issues, and resolve incidents.

product.name: PagerDuty Operations Cloud
product.description: A cloud-based operations platform for coordinating incident response, automation, AI-assisted analysis, and customer service workflows across an organization’s technology environment.

product.name: Incident Management
product.description: An end-to-end incident response product for detecting, routing, coordinating, resolving, and reviewing technology incidents.

product.name: AIOps
product.description: An operations intelligence product that aggregates and analyzes events to reduce alert noise, identify related issues, and accelerate incident triage.

product.name: Automation
product.description: A workflow automation product for executing operational tasks, remediation procedures, and repeatable actions across enterprise systems.

product.name: PagerDuty Advance
product.description: A generative AI capability integrated into PagerDuty for producing operational insights, assisting with incident work, and automating tasks such as status updates.

product.name: AI Agents
product.description: Autonomous and assistive agents for operational work, including issue identification, incident guidance, operational analysis, and on-call scheduling support.
